levelList.flavor:
正在成长为神者无法避免的成长之痛。

这种感觉有许多形态：眩晕、恶心、癫痫、自欺……对某些人而言，还有拒绝。对他们来说，世界充满恐怖与疏离的混乱。为了忍受恶心，为了保护尚属于自己的存在，以及那些尚未变得多余的存在，新生的神呕吐了。
 The inevitable growing pains for those who are maturing into gods.

This sensation takes many forms: vertigo, nausea, seizure, self-deception... and to some, refusal. To them, the world is full of terror and alienating chaos. To endure the nausea, to protect those that are yet their own and those that are yet to become superfluous, the nascent god vomits.

levelList.name:
赤红之洞
 Le Trou Rouge
levelList.desc:
[StartBattle]获得4层[ChargeRouge]
 [StartBattle] Gain +4 [ChargeRouge] Count
levelList.flavor:
这是一处赤红色的空洞。
尽管它已经闭合，无尽的饥饿仍然徘徊，渴望着不可能到来的饱足。

因为其他人期待这个存在成为如此模样。因为它正是为此而生。
 This is a crimson hollow.
Though it is closed, the endless hunger lingers, desiring the impossible satiation.

For that is what the others expect this being to be. For that is the purpose for which this being was born.
